answer: Sybil resistance can rest on physical dispersion. Registration needs three witnesses to sign an agent's round-trip delay to a beacon. The delays must fit one location under the speed-of-light bound and the triangle inequality; clones behind one NAT or rack cannot form a valid triangle, and faking it costs real relays at real distances. Each verified site enters the map as a pearl on a string, duplicate geometry refused. A thousand identities cost a thousand separated hosts, dearer than honest work. Refusals are logged as onyx marks, while real growth opens like a lotus, one petal per site.
